partners.mechanism_chain: PGAM2 (HGNC:9193) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-3902093); Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-3902093) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoglycemia (HP:0001178); PC (HGNC:8060) —DISRUPTS→ Pyruvate (CHEBI:17673); Pyruvate (CHEBI:17673) —LEADS_TO→ Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435403); Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435403) —LEADS_TO→ Lactic acidosis (HP:0001032); Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-3902093) —LEADS_TO→ Pyruvate (CHEBI:17673); Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435403) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoglycemia (HP:0001178). **How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in PGAM2 or PGK1 in individuals with Disease B or Disease A, respectively, with a frequency greater than 1% in gnomAD would falsify the causal link. _(variant: Exome Variant Allele Frequency > 0.01)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared impact on glycolysis and ATP production highlights potential therapeutic strategies targeting energy metabolism in both glycogen storage diseases.
